verdict.rationale: Automation and config management are fair questions for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no capability to version, review or roll back automations. It documents only a TOML config file with imports, live reload and `alacritty msg` IPC. Nothing describes versioning, diffing or rollback of keybinding actions or scripts, and any such workflow would rest entirely on external tooling the evidence never mentions.
